cases.sentence: — Вот Человек, — сказал Пилат, когда Иисус вышел в ___ и в пурпурной мантии.
cases.explain: «терновом венке» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”

cases.sentence: Когда Пилат это услышал, он вывел Иисуса, сел в судейское кресло на месте, называемом Каменный Помост, а на ___ Габбата.
cases.explain: «еврейском языке» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”

cases.sentence: Неся Свой крест, Иисус пошел на место, называемое Лобным , а на ___ — Голгофа .
cases.explain: «еврейском языке» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

cases.sentence: Иисус увидел Свою мать и Своего ___, стоявшего рядом с ней.
cases.explain: «любимого ученика» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”

cases.sentence: Там стоял кувшин с ___, и солдаты, обмакнув в него губку, надели ее на стебель иссопа и подняли к губам Иисуса .
cases.explain: «кислым вином» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

cases.sentence: Была пятница, и иудеи не хотели, чтобы тела оставались на крестах в субботу, тем более, что эта суббота была днем ___.
cases.explain: «великого праздника» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

cases.sentence: И в ___ Писания говорится: «Они будут смотреть на Того, Которого пронзили» .
cases.explain: «другом месте» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”

cases.explain: «погребальный обычай» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

cases.sentence: Там, где Иисуса распяли, был сад, и в саду — ___, где еще никого не хоронили.
cases.explain: «новая гробница» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.
